server.transport: actual SDK StreamableHTTPClientTransport and actual native HTTP entry

tools.name: cashflow_trend
tools.description: Read a 1–120 month income/expense series in one currency, including empty months, existing category/budget results and cumulative period net. Cumulative net starts at zero for the interval and is not an account balance. No conversion or write is performed.

toMonth.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM, on or after fromMonth; at most 120 months including both endpoints.

currency.description: Optional 3-letter selector for the whole interval. Required if its months resolve to multiple currencies. Existing unassigned-budget rules still apply.

tools.name: record_transaction
tools.description: Record a household income or expense transaction. Amounts are integer minor units (e.g. cents). Reuse an idempotencyKey with the same input to safely retry a recording after a lost response.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional stable key for one logical recording. Exact retries return the original transaction; changed input with the same key is refused. No surrounding whitespace.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: List/filter original transactions, newest first. Optional currency and literal category/note query combine with all other filters before counting and paging. No write or currency conversion is performed.

currency.description: Optional 3-letter currency filter, normalized to uppercase.

query.description: Literal case-insensitive substring of category or note. Surrounding query whitespace is ignored. Canonically equivalent Unicode text matches; no regular expressions or hidden record fields are searched.

tools.name: monthly_summary
tools.description: Income/expense totals, category breakdown and budgets in one currency for a month. Select currency when transactions or denominated budgets use multiple currencies. Unassigned budgets retain their legacy single-currency rule; ambiguous comparisons require explicit budget assignment.

currency.description: Optional 3-letter currency selector. Required when the month's transactions or denominated budgets use multiple currencies; normalized to uppercase. No conversion is performed.

tools.name: set_budget
tools.description: Create or replace a category budget (minor units) for a YYYY-MM month. Supply currency to keep a separate limit for that denomination. Replacing an unassigned budget with a denominated limit also requires replaceUnassigned: true. Omitted currency preserves unassigned-budget behavior and cannot overwrite a denominated budget.

currency.description: Optional explicit 3-letter budget currency, normalized to uppercase. Amounts are minor units of this currency.

replaceUnassigned.description: Set true to assign the supplied currency and limit to an existing unassigned category/month budget. Requires currency.

tools.name: get_budgets
tools.description: List category budgets for a YYYY-MM month. Omit currency to include all denominated and unassigned budgets; selecting currency returns only budgets explicitly assigned that denomination.

currency.description: Optional 3-letter currency filter for explicitly denominated budgets, normalized to uppercase.

tools.name: preview_transaction_import
tools.description: Validate and preview a complete CSV of household transactions without writing. Requires a stable native idempotencyKey per row. Shows exact normalized values, original matching/conflicting records and per-currency totals. Review every row before committing; raw CSV is not persisted.

csv.description: Complete CSV text, up to 256 KiB UTF-8 and 500 rows. Required headers: idempotencyKey,type,amountMinor,currency,date,category; optional note. Amounts are positive integer minor units. No bank-format inference or missing-field defaults.

tools.name: commit_transaction_import
tools.description: After the user reviews the exact normalized CSV preview, import its entire batch atomically through the existing ledger writer. Supply the same CSV and reviewToken. Current matching keys return original records without duplication; any conflict refuses all additions. A retry of the same content is safe. Run one server process per ledger file.

csv.description: The exact complete CSV text that was reviewed.

reviewToken.description: Content-binding token returned by preview_transaction_import. It does not lock the ledger or authenticate approval; current keys are rechecked inside the writer.
